scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix shared install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shared run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
